description.value: The Westerly Restaurant is the on-site dining venue inside The Westerly Hotel in Courtenay, offering a daily breakfast buffet and an entertainment-focused bar lounge (the Chalk Lounge) with pool tables, darts, and craft beverages. Situated in the heart of the Comox Valley — a region rich in cycling, hiking, and outdoor recreation — it provides a convenient full-service food stop in the centre of town. The hotel is a Best Western property with 24-hour front desk and full hotel amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the on-site dining venue of The Westerly Hotel at 1590 Cliffe Avenue, Courtenay BC. The OSM name 'Westerly Family Restaurant' does not match the website's branding, which refers to the restaurant as 'The Westerly Restaurant' (breakfast buffet) and the lounge area as the 'Chalk Lounge.' The amenities page explicitly confirms free public Wi-Fi; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM name is 'Westerly Family Restaurant' but the website brands the dining venue as 'The Westerly Restaurant' (breakfast) and 'Chalk Lounge' (bar/lounge). The hotel brand is 'The Westerly Hotel' / 'Best Western The Westerly Hotel'.
OSM record contains no address, phone, or email tags — all contact information was sourced from the website.

The dining page description focuses heavily on bar/lounge entertainment (pool tables, darts, HD TVs, cocktails) rather than a family restaurant experience; the breakfast buffet is mentioned separately. The 'Family Restaurant' designation in the OSM name may be inaccurate or outdated.
No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, pump) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM name 'Westerly Family Restaurant' does not match the website's branding and the venue appears to be primarily a hotel bar/lounge (Chalk Lounge) with a breakfast buffet rather than a standalone family restaurant; the listing may benefit from a name correction and verification that the OSM node accurately represents a cyclist-accessible dining stop rather than a hotel-guest-only venue.
enrichment_extras.notes: Complementary parking is listed as a hotel amenity, which may be relevant context for cyclists arriving by vehicle. The hotel also lists a baggage hold service, which could potentially accommodate cycling gear.
